description: This file defines middleware for a FastAPI application that handles token validation, error handling, logging, and request processing. It includes a class for middleware implementation, utility functions for generating error responses, and session validation logic.

classes.name: TokenValidationMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class for validating authentication tokens, handling API errors, and logging API access attempts. It skips validation for specific exempt paths and manages different exception scenarios to provide standardized JSON error responses.

methods.name: __init__(self, app, exempt_paths: list = None)
methods.description: Initializes the middleware with the application instance and optional list of paths to exempt from validation.

methods.name: Response dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable)
methods.description: Processes incoming requests, logs access attempts, checks for exempt paths, and handles exceptions such as HTTP exceptions, external API errors, and unexpected errors by returning structured JSON responses.

methods.name: JSONResponse create_error_response( status_code: int, message: str, error_code: str = None, details: dict = None )

ctags.name: create_error_response
ctags.signature: ( status_code: int, message: str, error_code: str = None, details: dict = None )

ctags.name: dispatch
ctags.pattern: /^    async def dispatch(self, request: Request, call_next: Callable) -> Response:$/
